items.zh_full: 本研究提出了一种用于二维系统中多参数量子度量（quantum metrology）的高效自适应控制策略。该工作发表于《Communications Physics》。量子度量旨在利用量子资源（如纠缠、压缩）提升参数估计精度，是量子传感与量子精密测量的核心基础。在多参数估计场景中，不同参数对应的测量基通常不对易，导致无法同时达到各参数的量子极限，且参数间的串扰会显著影响估计性能。针对这一挑战，研究团队开发了基于自适应反馈的控制方案，通过实时调整测量策略来优化多参数联合估计的精度。该策略特别针对二维量子系统（如单量子比特系统）进行了设计与验证。在二维系统中，参数空间结构相对简单，但多参数估计的优化问题依然具有代表性。自适应控制的核心思想是：根据前期测量获得的信息，动态更新后续测量的基或操作，从而逐步逼近最优测量策略。这种闭环反馈机制能够有效抑制参数间的干扰，并提升整体估计效率。研究结果表明，该自适应策略在多个参数同时估计时，能够显著降低估计误差，其性能优于非自适应或固定测量策略。此外，该方案在实验实现上具有可行性，所需资源（如快速反馈控制、可调测量基）在当前量子技术平台上已具备。该工作为多参数量子度量提供了新的理论工具，并为未来量子传感网络、量子成像及量子导航等应用提供了技术支撑。其意义在于：不仅深化了对量子多参数估计理论的理解，也为实际量子精密测量系统的优化设计提供了可操作的指导方案。

Now, researchers from China have achieved a new low-temperature record aboard their Tiangong space station. Their research, recently published in Science, might lead to a new generation of experiments in quantum physics and precision measurements in space.

items.title: Electrical control of an unconventional quantum transport state demonstrated in a magnet for the first time
items.summary: Researchers at Tohoku University and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (JAEA) have successfully controlled a unique quantum phenomenon—the quantum-geometric nonlinear Hall (QgNLH) state—using electric current for the first time. The breakthrough was achieved by revealing and exploiting the coupling between the spin structure and the QgNLH state in an electrically switchable chiral antiferromagnet.

items.title: How palm orientation shapes spin characteristics in volleyball jump serves
items.summary: A new biomechanical study has uncovered how elite volleyball players control ball spin during jump serves, offering fresh scientific insight into one of the sport's most decisive offensive skills.

items.title: After 40 years of searching, physicists find evidence for an ultrarare particle decay
items.summary: Physicists at CERN report that they've detected evidence of a rare meson particle decay (B⁰→ µ⁺µ⁻) that occurs when the meson's beauty quark annihilates with a down-type quark. The pair decays into a muon and antimuon, which are particles similar to electrons. Because evidence for this decay helps test theoretical predictions from the Standard Model, physicists have been waiting for it since 1984, when it was first theorized.

items.title: When Einstein's gravitational waves meet Newton's tides
items.summary: Newton's theory of gravity has described the tides accurately for centuries. But could a tiny trace of Einstein's general relativity also be hidden in them? In a new study, a mathematician at Freie Universität Berlin has outlined how a targeted approach could be used to search for effects of this nature.

items.title: Five things to know about guiding sound for better communication

items.title: Finding the fingerprints of noisy distributions in random quantum systems
items.summary: Imagine shuffling a deck of cards where some of the cards are fading just because of the way they interact with the external environment as you shuffle them. items.title: A single measurement makes quantum bits more reliable
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Regensburg and their international partners have found a way to significantly reduce errors in quantum bits. In an experiment, they demonstrated that a single additional measurement before a series of quantum operations can cut the error rate by more than half. The results have been published in Applied Physics Reviews.

items.summary: 许家窑人的身份在分子层面得到确认，也让研究者第一次有机会系统认识丹尼索瓦人的形态特征。
items.zh_full: 许家窑人的身份在分子层面得到确认，也让研究者第一次有机会系统认识丹尼索瓦人的形态特征。这一发现为理解30万至10万年前东亚大地上古人类的分布提供了关键线索。此前，丹尼索瓦人主要依据西伯利亚丹尼索瓦洞穴的少量化石和DNA证据被认识，而许家窑人化石的分子鉴定结果，将丹尼索瓦人的地理分布范围显著扩展至中国北方。研究者通过对比许家窑人与其他古人类化石的形态特征，首次系统梳理了丹尼索瓦人的形态学面貌，为区分丹尼索瓦人与其他古人类支系提供了形态学依据。这一工作表明，在30万至10万年前的东亚，丹尼索瓦人可能是该地区的主要古人类群体之一，对理解东亚古人类演化网络具有重要价值。
items.llm_summary: 许家窑人化石经分子鉴定确认为丹尼索瓦人，这是首次在分子层面确认东亚古人类身份，并首次系统认识丹尼索瓦人形态特征。结果显示30万至10万年前东亚大地上的古人类可能大多是丹尼索瓦人，为东亚古人类演化研究提供了关键证据。
